Poultry producers, starch manufacturers, and ethanol plants are all vying for limited maize resources, exacerbating the situation. As maize prices continue to rise, the poultry industry has expressed concerns about potential feed shortages. Industry bodies have urged the government to prioritize maize for food production over fuel use.

articles.title: CBDT mandates new disclosures for tax-free gains on govt securities
articles.desc: The Central Board of Direct Taxes has introduced new disclosure requirements for taxpayers claiming exemptions. Taxpayers will need to provide detailed information on government securities to qualify for these exemptions. Newly inserted Form 173A will require specific data, including securities value and interest earned. Taxpayers are asked to confirm the accuracy of the information they submit. This change aims to enhance transparency and compliance under the Income-Tax Act.

A nine-member committee will review the policy to reflect recent developments, especially in critical minerals. The committee is expected to submit recommendations within two months after its formation. Experts emphasize the need for a revised policy to enhance India's mineral potential and investment.

articles.title: Drill, baby, drill: China turns the screws, India looks for own tools

The proposed package aims to attract $1.8 billion in investment over seven years, but the bigger challenge will be building local capabilities in high-value components and machinery rather than simply replacing Chinese imports.
